items.name: .codecov.yml
items.excerpt:
1: comment: false
2: coverage:
3:   status:
4:     project: off
5:     patch: off

items.name: .coveragerc
items.excerpt:
1: [run]
2: # measure 'branch' coverage in addition to 'statement' coverage
3: # See: http://coverage.readthedocs.org/en/coverage-4.0.3/branch.html#branch
4: branch = True
5: 
6: # list of directories or packages to measure
7: source = glyphsLib
8: 
9: # these are treated as equivalent when combining data
10: [paths]
11: source =
12:     Lib/glyphsLib
13:     .tox/*/lib/python*/site-packages/glyphsLib

items.name: .editorconfig
items.excerpt:
1: # http://editorconfig.org
2: 
3: root = true
4: 
5: [*]
6: indent_style = space
7: indent_size = 4
8: trim_trailing_whitespace = true
9: insert_final_newline = true
10: charset = utf-8
11: end_of_line = lf
12: 
13: [*.{yaml,yml}]

items.name: .gitattributes
items.excerpt:
1: # Set the default behavior, in case people don't have core.autocrlf set.
2: * text=auto
3: 
4: # Explicitly declare text files you want to always be normalized and converted
5: # to native line endings on checkout.
6: *.cfg text
7: *.in text
8: *.ini text
9: *.md text
10: *.py text
11: *.rst text
12: *.txt text
13: *.yaml text

items.name: .gitignore
items.excerpt:
1: # Byte-compiled / optimized / DLL files
2: __pycache__/
3: *.py[cod]
4: *$py.class
5: 
6: # C extensions
7: *.so
8: 
9: # Distribution / packaging
10: .Python
11: build/
12: develop-eggs/
13: dist/

commits.message:
Specify default interpolation values in casting.py

This is consistent with how the default master width/weight values are
specified. Now outside code doesn't need to know any default values.
